title: Release of the album Taylor Swift
description: Release of her self-titled debut studio album through Big Machine Records.

title: Release of Love Story
description: Breakthrough single that helped launch her international career.

title: Release of the album Fearless
description: Her second studio album, which later won her first Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: Start of the Fearless Tour
description: Her first headlining tour begins in Evansville, Indiana.

title: First Album of the Year Grammy for Fearless
description: At the 52nd Grammy Awards, she becomes the youngest solo artist at the time to win Album of the Year.

title: End of the Fearless Tour
description: The tour concludes in Cavendish, Canada.

title: Release of the album Speak Now
description: Her third studio album, written entirely by Swift.

title: Start of the Speak Now World Tour
description: The world tour kicks off in Singapore.

title: End of the Speak Now World Tour
description: The tour concludes in Auckland, New Zealand.

title: Release of the album Red
description: Her fourth studio album marks a gradual transition toward pop music.

title: Start of The Red Tour
description: The tour opens in Omaha, Nebraska.

title: End of The Red Tour
description: The tour concludes in Singapore.

title: Announcement of 1989 and release of Shake It Off
description: During a Yahoo! livestream, she announces her first fully pop studio album.

title: Release of the album 1989
description: Her fifth studio album becomes a major international critical and commercial success.

title: Start of The 1989 World Tour
description: The tour opens at Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan.

title: End of The 1989 World Tour
description: The final show takes place at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in Australia.

title: Second Album of the Year Grammy for 1989
description: At the 58th Grammy Awards, she becomes the first woman to win Album of the Year twice as a lead artist.

title: Announcement of reputation
description: After wiping her social media accounts, she reveals the album title and cover.

title: Release of the album reputation
description: Her sixth studio album and final album released through Big Machine Records.

title: Start of the reputation Stadium Tour
description: The tour opens at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona.

title: Signing with Republic Records / Universal Music Group
description: Her new global recording deal gives her ownership of the masters for her future recordings.

title: End of the reputation Stadium Tour
description: The final show takes place at Tokyo Dome in Japan.

title: Announcement of Lover
description: She announces the album title and You Need to Calm Down during an Instagram livestream.

title: Sale of Big Machine Records to Scooter Braun
description: Ithaca Holdings acquires Big Machine Label Group, including the masters of her first six albums, without her consent.

title: Announcement of plans to re-record her first six albums
description: In television interviews, she confirms her intention to create new recordings of her early albums.

title: Release of the album Lover
description: Her seventh studio album and first Republic Records project for which she owns the masters.

title: Surprise announcement of folklore
description: She announces her eighth studio album less than 24 hours before release.

title: Release of the album folklore
description: Her eighth studio album, an indie-folk-inspired project created during the COVID-19 lockdown.

title: Resale of her original masters to Shamrock Holdings
description: She reveals that Ithaca Holdings has sold her original recording catalog to Shamrock Holdings.

title: Surprise announcement of evermore
description: She reveals her ninth studio album, described as a sister record to folklore.

title: Release of the album evermore
description: Her ninth studio album.

title: Announcement of Fearless (Taylor’s Version)
description: She officially announces her first re-recorded album on Good Morning America.

title: Third Album of the Year Grammy for folklore
description: At the 63rd Grammy Awards, she becomes the first woman to win Album of the Year three times.

title: Release of Fearless (Taylor’s Version)
description: Her first released re-recording includes six previously unreleased From the Vault tracks.

title: Announcement of Red (Taylor’s Version)
description: She announces the re-recorded edition of Red on social media.

title: Release of Red (Taylor’s Version)
description: Her second re-recorded album features the full ten-minute version of All Too Well.

title: Announcement of Midnights at the MTV VMAs
description: She reveals her tenth studio album during the awards ceremony.

title: Release of the album Midnights
description: Her tenth studio album is followed three hours later by the 3am Edition.

title: Official announcement of The Eras Tour
description: She announces a tour celebrating the different eras of her musical career.

title: Start of The Eras Tour
description: The tour opens at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, temporarily renamed Swift City, Arizona.

title: Announcement of Speak Now (Taylor’s Version)
description: She reveals the third re-recorded album onstage in Nashville during The Eras Tour.

title: Release of Speak Now (Taylor’s Version)
description: Her third re-recorded album.

title: Announcement of 1989 (Taylor’s Version)
description: She makes the announcement at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood during the final show of the first US leg.

title: Announcement of Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour concert film
description: She announces the theatrical release of her concert film.

title: Theatrical release of Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour
description: The concert film opens internationally, following preview screenings the night before.

title: Release of 1989 (Taylor’s Version)
description: Her fourth re-recorded album arrives exactly nine years after the original.

title: Fourth Album of the Year Grammy for Midnights
description: At the 66th Grammy Awards, she becomes the first artist to win Album of the Year four times.

title: Announcement of The Tortured Poets Department at the Grammys
description: She announces her eleventh studio album while accepting Best Pop Vocal Album.

title: Release of The Tortured Poets Department and The Anthology
description: Her eleventh studio album expands into a 31-track double album with 15 additional songs released two hours later.

title: End of The Eras Tour
description: The record-breaking world tour concludes at BC Place in Vancouver, Canada.

title: Purchase of her original master recordings
description: She announces that she has acquired ownership of the original masters of her first six albums.

title: Announcement of The Life of a Showgirl
description: She reveals her twelfth studio album following an online countdown.

title: The Life of a Showgirl release date and tracklist revealed
description: During an appearance on New Heights, she discusses the album, its October 3 release date, and the Sabrina Carpenter collaboration.

title: Engagement to Travis Kelce announced
description: Swift and NFL player Travis Kelce publicly announce their engagement.

title: Announcement of The Official Release Party of a Showgirl
description: She announces a limited theatrical event accompanying her new album, including the premiere of The Fate of Ophelia music video.

title: Release of The Life of a Showgirl
description: Her twelfth studio album is released, featuring 12 tracks including a collaboration with Sabrina Carpenter.

title: Release of The Official Release Party of a Showgirl
description: A limited-run theatrical event features music videos, commentary, and behind-the-scenes footage.

title: Record-breaking debut for The Life of a Showgirl
description: The album achieves more than four million equivalent US units in its first week, setting a new benchmark for an album debut.

title: Announcement of Eras Tour documentary and final concert film
description: Disney announces The End of an Era docuseries and The Eras Tour: The Final Show for Disney+.

title: Disney+ release of The Eras Tour: The Final Show
description: The complete Vancouver concert film becomes available on Disney+, including The Tortured Poets Department set.

title: Premiere of The End of an Era
description: The six-episode Disney+ documentary series about the making and impact of The Eras Tour begins streaming.

title: Songwriters Hall of Fame induction announced
description: Swift is named among the 2026 inductees to the Songwriters Hall of Fame.

title: Opalite tops the Billboard Hot 100
description: The second single from The Life of a Showgirl reaches number one on the US singles chart.

title: Induction into the Songwriters Hall of Fame
description: She joins the 2026 class of inductees at the New York ceremony.

title: Marriage to Travis Kelce
description: Swift and Kelce marry in New York City.

title: Announcement of The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore
description: She announces an expanded edition of her 2025 album with four new tracks.

title: Release of The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore
description: The expanded album arrives with four new tracks, including Patient Zero, Cleveland!, Babylon, and Pink Clouding.

title: Premiere of the Patient Zero music video at the MTV VMAs
description: The Swift-directed video featuring Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell debuts during the awards ceremony.

title: MTV VMA Artist Director Honors and Video of the Year
description: Swift receives the inaugural Artist Director Honors and wins Video of the Year for The Fate of Ophelia.

title: Patient Zero reaches number one on the Billboard Hot 100
description: The single tops the US chart following the release of The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore.
